March 8, 2018 - By Nellie Frank 
Miles Capital Inc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 23.93% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Miles Capital Inc sold 4,031 shares as the company’s stock rose 12.78% with the market. The institutional investor held 12,816 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $1.98 million, down from 16,847 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Miles Capital Inc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $896.02B market cap company. The stock increased 0.89% or $1.56 during the last trading session, reaching $176.59. About 10.95 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 62.48% since March 8, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 45.78% the S&P500. 
David Dreman increased its stake in Cvs Caremark Corp Common Stock Usd.01 (CVS) by 83.53% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Dreman Value Management Llc bought 11,568 shares as the company’s stock declined 4.23% while stock markets rallied. The hedge fund run by David Dreman held 25,417 shares of the medical and nursing services company at the end of 2017Q3, valued at $2.07M, up from 13,849 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Dreman Value Management Llc who had been investing in Cvs Caremark Corp Common Stock Usd.01 for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $69.15B market cap company. The stock increased 0.96% or $0.6514 during the last trading session, reaching $68.1614. About 3.98M shares traded. CVS Health Corporation (NYSE:CVS) has declined 24.40% since March 8, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 41.10% the S&P500.
